name: RTI-51
summary: (–)-2β-Carbomethoxy-3β-(4-bromophenyl)tropane (RTI-4229-51, bromopane) is a semi-synthetic alkaloid in the phenyltropane group of psychostimulant compounds. First publicized in the 1990s, it has not been used enough to have gained a fully established profile. RTI-51 can be expected to have properties lying somewhere in between RTI-31 and RTI-55.

pharmacology.text: It has been used in its 76Br radiolabelled form to map the distribution of dopamine transporters in the brain. More recent work has advocated using cloned human transporters.

uses.text: First publicized in the 1990s, it has not been used enough to have gained a fully established profile. It has been used in its 76Br radiolabelled form to map the distribution of dopamine transporters in the brain.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants of this kind can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, anxiety, sleeplessness, overheating and paranoia, and repeated use can lead to compulsive redosing and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類興奮劑可能引起心跳過快、高血壓、焦慮、失眠、體溫過高和偏執，反覆使用可能導致強迫性追加和依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类兴奋剂可能引起心跳过快、高血压、焦虑、失眠、体温过高和偏执，反复使用可能导致强迫性追加和依赖。

fact.en: RTI-51 carries a bromine atom. In a radioactive form it has been used to map dopamine transporters in the living brain.
fact.zh: RTI-51 帶有一個溴原子。它的放射性形式曾被用來描繪活體腦中多巴胺轉運蛋白的分布。
fact.zhHans: RTI-51 带有一个溴原子。它的放射性形式曾被用来描绘活体脑中多巴胺转运蛋白的分布。
